These are likely the target molecule (product) with protecting groups. The template is for Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) reaction: forms alkene from aldehyde/ketone and phosphonate. The template likely breaks a C-P bond and C-O bond, forming C=C and carboxylic acid. So applying retrosynthetic template to the target should give precursors: a phosphonate (or phosphonate carbanion) and an aldehyde/ketone? Actually HWE: aldehyde + phosphonate => alkene + phosphate byproduct. In retrosynthesis, we break the C=C to give aldehyde (or ketone) and phosphonate (with a carboxylate). The template ID 186218 presumably does that.
